headline: The first season now pays off, Trophy Road keeps real chronology, and tablet keyboard focus returns safely; one exact artifact is verified on staging, production Pages, and the backend while public launch remains independent.

items.title: The first completed season reaches its reckoning
items.evidence: One previous/current transition predicate keeps initial load quiet and invokes the existing review, epilogue, feedback, and reward path exactly once for the first real completion.

items.title: Trophy Road preserves the league's chronology
items.evidence: The streak projection now honors GameSession's year/week-descending receipts; current-year Week 1 is no longer displaced by prior-year Week 18.

items.title: Keyboard focus survives responsive navigation
items.evidence: One orientation-aware handler owns Arrow/Home/End behavior, preserves desktop roving focus, and returns tablet focus to the visible toggle before the drawer becomes inert.

items.title: One exact candidate reached every technical surface
items.evidence: Source 3cce0a51e82e78625bdfad82f1cbdb19a31c94aa and artifact 6bdc133a478cfee8a8b19321a5684001b65e3322210e1a090b573785240bc7f4 agree across visual, performance, staging 14/14, production 10/10, CI 33769176381, Pages 33770515766, and backend 33770517153.

followUps.title: Observe the first genuine opted-in cohort
followUps.evidence: Validate freshness, suppression, deletion, and abuse ceilings from real consented activity; do not manufacture a cohort.

followUps.title: Restore the stats surface only after its evidence threshold
followUps.evidence: Return /stats to the sitemap only when the community snapshot clears the declared suppression floor.

followUps.title: Reconcile public launch independently
followUps.evidence: Require Zoho receive/reply-as, explicit SHA-bound approval, authoritative lifecycle state, and applicable external Obelisk relying-party proof before any public-launch flip.

blockers.title: Public launch remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Technical deployment is complete. Email delivery/reply-as, public-launch approval, lifecycle authority, external Obelisk registration, and cohort evidence remain independently unverified.

honestyLedger.title: The first release pass was correctly rejected
honestyLedger.evidence: The boot gate found a stale preload graph and a strict shell 1,892 bytes over budget. The graph was simplified and preloads rebuilt; the ceiling was not raised.

honestyLedger.title: The first production pass was superseded honestly
honestyLedger.evidence: After the initial exact artifact was promoted, public-truth caught the status page at S96. The note was fixed and a new immutable candidate was rebuilt, staged, remeasured, and re-promoted across Pages and backend; the older deployment remains only as rollback and audit history.

honestyLedger.title: The test boundaries remain distinct
honestyLedger.evidence: Canonical local Node is 1,303/1,303 across six shards; push CI is 1,298/1,298 across five configured shards; the release browser suite is 55/55.

honestyLedger.title: Rendered proof is source-bound
honestyLedger.evidence: Two hundred fifty-five game states yielded 98 retained exact-candidate captures, and four status-page captures covered desktop/mobile in both themes; direct inspection found zero blocking defects.

honestyLedger.title: Visual retention preserved proof
honestyLedger.evidence: Ninety-two Session 95 PNGs moved outside the three-session window only after all hashes were preserved; they remain recoverable from Git history.

honestyLedger.title: Deployment is not public launch
honestyLedger.evidence: The founder authorized commit, push, and full technical deployment, not a lifecycle or launchReady flip. The independent launch holds remain explicit.

diffStat.suite: Canonical Node 1,303/1,303; push CI 1,298/1,298; Playwright 55/55; responsive 255 game states with 98 exact-candidate captures plus four status captures; staging 14/14; production 10/10; backend exact; unified release authority verified; launchReady false.
